{{Top|leg}}
A '''trapped grip''' was a special [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] modification. It was essentially a hidden booby trap integrated into the lightsaber's [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|handle]] that would harm any unauthorized person who tried to activate it. The trap was disarmed by the lightsaber's wielder by a simple action, such as pressing down on a hidden sensor or twisting a knob. Otherwise, an energy discharge would damage the person for as long as they held the lightsaber without disarming the trap.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>
